title: DeliveryAcknowledgement
description: Response to /v1/findings: IDs the scanner may remove from its queue (durably stored, including earlier duplicates, or permanently refused); the refused ones are also listed in rejected_findings with a reason.

rejected_findings.description: Findings refused permanently. Each finding_id is also in accepted_finding_ids. Readers ignore reasons they do not know.

reason.description: future_observation, retention_expired, out_of_range, or unstorable; readers ignore others.
